property_summary: For every admissible guess hash and subsequent settle, the reference pays the 2 ether prize if and only if the guess equals the blockhash-derived answer, so a winning caller's c balance only increases by the payout when their guess matches, while the mutant pays out exactly when the guess does not match.
change_summary: Change the settling branch condition from equality to inequality, paying out when the guess is wrong instead of when it matches.
